summary: @ornikar/jest-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, an obfuscated script (hex-encoded identifiers, property-alias objects) that downloads a Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the Bun binary, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-CJS module (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with rotated numeric/string constant array and index-based lookup indirection characteristic of javascript-obfuscator output. The payload is not referenced by the advertised jest-config functionality (jest-preset.js does not require it), and executing it under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based inspection. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install` for every installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
